name: Stabilization and Gap Audit
goal: Establish a factual V1 baseline, close misleading navigation gaps, and make core regression coverage repeatable before v2 feature work.
entryCriteria: EduAI 2.0 canonical roadmap and task migration passes AI-DOS conformance.
Backend and frontend main branches are available for audit.
exitCriteria: The page/API/authorization coverage matrix and prioritized gap list are current.
Visible navigation no longer silently falls back to unrelated pages.
Deterministic core V1 regression evidence is recorded for both repositories.

name: Platform Administration
goal: Deliver a dedicated, secure administration domain with operational dashboards, user management, moderation, and audit history.
entryCriteria: Sprint 13 exit criteria are verified.
exitCriteria: Platform administrators have dedicated role-protected APIs and UI.
Sensitive administration and moderation mutations are safeguarded and audited.

name: Learning Completion and Assessment V2
goal: Make completion, quiz, assignment, and certificate state authoritative, policy-driven, idempotent, and auditable.
entryCriteria: Sprint 14 exit criteria are verified.
exitCriteria: Course completion is derived transactionally from required learning and assessment records.
Quiz, assignment, and certificate policies preserve history and enforce server-side integrity.

name: Notifications
goal: Provide scoped, idempotent in-app, realtime, and preference-controlled email notifications.
entryCriteria: Sprint 15 exit criteria are verified.
exitCriteria: Notification creation, reads, deduplication, and preferences are authoritative and user-scoped.
Realtime and email delivery failures do not block core transactions.

name: AI Learning Path
goal: Turn learner goals and authorized EduAI data into validated, versioned learning paths and a course-grounded tutor experience.
entryCriteria: Sprint 16 exit criteria are verified.
exitCriteria: Learner goals and generated paths are private, validated, versioned, and persisted.
AI tutor retrieval and citations respect course and library authorization boundaries.

name: Career Hub
goal: Connect verified learner profiles and skills to published job opportunities, private applications, and explainable matching.
entryCriteria: Sprint 17 exit criteria are verified.
exitCriteria: Career profiles reuse authoritative learning/profile data with explicit privacy controls.
Job publication, application, status history, and matching rules are enforced server-side.

name: Mentor System
goal: Add approved mentor profiles, timezone-safe availability, transactional booking, secure Jitsi sessions, and privacy-aware outcomes.
entryCriteria: Sprint 18 exit criteria are verified.
exitCriteria: Mentor discovery and booking transitions are authorized, conflict-safe, and notification-aware.
Session access, attendance, private notes, shared goals, and reviews enforce their privacy policies.

name: Production Readiness V2
goal: Harden, observe, optimize, accept, deploy, and verify EduAI 2.0 in production.
entryCriteria: All Sprint 13 through Sprint 19 feature exit criteria are verified.
exitCriteria: Security, ownership, abuse limits, health, observability, accessibility, and performance gates pass.
Cross-role UAT, deployment, rollback, release notes, and production verification at the configured URL pass.

name: Priority Product Experience Track
goal: Deliver Mobile UX/navigation, Voucher, Scholarship, TMI Rewards, PWA/installability, and only then the final demo course dataset and integrated regression/UAT without interrupting active work or adding payment/WordPress runtime.
entryCriteria: The repository and AI-DOS audit is recorded in EduAI_Docs/docs/v2/04-priority-product-audit.md.
The existing SPR17-002 IN_PROGRESS state remains unchanged.
Task dependencies and acceptance metadata pass AI-DOS conformance.
exitCriteria: Mobile UX and navigation are usable at supported phone and desktop viewports.
Minimal synthetic fixtures support focused feature tests without being the final demo dataset.
Voucher, scholarship, and TMI flows have server-authoritative security and UAT evidence.
The approved PWA path is installable or explicitly bounded by browser support evidence.
The final demo course dataset and integrated regression/UAT complete the track only after all feature domains and PWA work are stable.

extensions.schedulingPolicy: Prioritize runnable Sprint 21 by canonical CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW values and explicit dependencies; final demo tasks are release-gated after Voucher, Scholarship, TMI, and PWA.

name: Production UI/UX Refinement
goal: Raise EduAI's existing production interface to a cohesive, premium, accessible, mobile-first product experience without changing business logic or API contracts.
entryCriteria: EduAI 2.0 release and Sprint 21 integrated regression are complete.
The production baseline, repository routes, design guidance, and existing worktrees are audited before implementation.
exitCriteria: Shared UI foundations and major public/authenticated route families use a coherent responsive design language.
Course discovery, mobile navigation and notifications, core learning/dashboard surfaces, accessibility, builds, tests, browser QA, deployment, and production verification have structured evidence.

name: Commerce Foundation
goal: Establish stable commerce contracts, persistence, cart pricing, pending orders, and administrator operations before external settlement.
entryCriteria: Sprint 22 is complete.
Phase 3 product decisions and exclusions are documented.
exitCriteria: Course carts and pending orders use server-authoritative pricing snapshots.
Commerce authorization, concurrency, audit, builds, and focused regression pass.

name: Membership and Entitlements
goal: Deliver versioned administrator-configurable memberships and centralized course and service entitlements.
entryCriteria: Sprint 23 commerce persistence and contracts are stable.
exitCriteria: Plans, durations, prices, discounts, services, quotas, and included courses are configurable and versioned.
Membership access, renewal, plan changes, removed-course grace, tests, and UAT pass.

name: PayOS Payment and Fulfillment
goal: Accept VietQR payments through PayOS, verify settlement server-side, fulfill orders atomically, and reconcile failures safely.
entryCriteria: Commerce order contracts and membership fulfillment targets are available.
PayOS merchant credentials can be configured outside source control.
exitCriteria: Signed idempotent webhooks are the authoritative payment transition.
Course and membership fulfillment, reconciliation, refunds, security, deployment, and production UAT pass.

name: Advanced Analytics
goal: Provide trusted revenue, membership, product, funnel, voucher, and entitlement-usage analytics from authoritative commerce records.
entryCriteria: Sprint 25 settlement and fulfillment records are authoritative and production verified.
exitCriteria: Metric definitions reconcile with orders and payments.
Admin analytics, exports, privacy, performance, and UAT pass.

name: Affiliate
goal: Attribute eligible orders, calculate auditable commissions, and support administrator-reviewed withdrawal requests without automatic payouts.
entryCriteria: Payment settlement is stable.
Analytics metric and privacy contracts are defined.
exitCriteria: Attribution and commission ledgers reconcile with eligible paid and refunded orders.
Affiliate/admin workflows, abuse controls, security, and UAT pass.

name: Phase 3 Release
goal: Release Phase 3 only after financial, access, analytics, affiliate, security, observability, performance, rollback, and production gates pass.
entryCriteria: Sprints 23 through 27 are complete with structured evidence.
exitCriteria: Cross-role production UAT and financial reconciliation pass.
Deployment, rollback, security, observability, accessibility, and performance evidence support release closure.
